title: Puharich's wife's suicide

tellings.quote: I received a grim call from Jenny's father.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a medical researcher the episode calls a CIA scientist and who later said he contacted an alien council, recalls in his own words getting "a grim call" from the father of his wife, Jenny, in the late 1950s. The story is of her suicide and the hospital where it ended, told first-hand as a turning point in his personal life.
